label: 普通／常见
description: 能够稳定制作、种植、采集或流通的物品；品质仍可有好坏，但通常不依赖少数专门渠道。
description_en: Reliably made, grown, gathered, or traded; quality can vary without requiring a specialist source.

label: 稀有
description: 需要较高工艺、有限产地、专业资格或稳定特殊性质，能够获得但不在普通市场随处可见。
description_en: Requires advanced craft, a limited source, specialist access, or a stable special property.

label: 罕见
description: 只有少数工坊、组织或环境能够稳定提供，取得、使用和维护通常都需要明确条件。
description_en: Reliably supplied only by a few workshops, institutions, or environments, with explicit access and upkeep conditions.

label: 传说
description: 已知世界中极少数真正存在的具体物品；每一件都有明确名称、来历与历史记录，传说等级属于那一件物品，不能作为普通制式批量生成。
description_en: A very small number of named individual items with established provenance and history; this tier cannot be mass-produced as a standard design.

label: 神话
description: 几乎不可复现、原则上仅此一件的具体物品，并与神明、法则或世界级事件直接相关；必须经过世界观共同确立，不能仅凭剧情中的夸张名称获得。
description_en: A unique individual item tied directly to divinity, law, or a world-scale event; it must be established in canon rather than inferred from a grand name.
